name: Dindori

boundary_provenance.source_url: n/a - replace with India Geodata / DataMeet GP GeoJSON
boundary_provenance.note: NOT official Gram Panchayat boundaries and NOT community-mapped boundaries. A regular grid over the pilot block envelope is used so the pipeline can run; every area weight and map polygon is illustrative. Drop a real GeoJSON at data/boundaries/LGD-271012.geojson to replace it.

selection_rationale: PRD S22 criteria: (a) 5-15 Panchayats - 11 are defined here; (b) accessible geometry - a single compact envelope inside one taluka; (c) visible elevation/terrain variation - 520 m to 968 m across the block, which is what makes the downscaling claim demonstrable; (d) access to historical data - the block sits inside the Nashik agrometeorological belt where ERA5-Land/CHIRPS tiles and IMD gridded products are routinely staged; (e) nearby observations - IMD AWS/ARG stations exist in the Nashik district (Probe via Track B). The block id LGD-271012 is the one used in the PRD API example; adopting it keeps contract and implementation aligned. IMPORTANT: the Panchayat names, LGD codes, cell polygons and terrain attributes below are ILLUSTRATIVE - they are not a verified official administrative extract, and the boundary source is disclosed as schematic everywhere in the product.
elevation_reference: zbar_block is computed as the area-weighted mean elevation of the Panchayats below, per PRD S7.
